name: Epilator
definition: powered device whose rotating tweezer discs pull hairs out by the root.
notes: Braun Silk-epil epilators sold with electric tweezers; rotating-disc design not stated on page.

name: Multi-styler
definition: powered hot-air styler sold with interchangeable drying, curling and smoothing attachments.
notes: Dyson sells Airwrap as multi-styler with drying, curling, smoothing attachments.

name: Eyeshadow
definition: coloured powder, cream or liquid applied to the eyelids (palette and single are formats).
notes: Sephora Eyeshadow category sells individual shades and palettes.

name: Brow pencil
definition: pencil or powder that fills and shapes the eyebrows with colour.
notes: Brow Wiz sold as retractable eyebrow pencil with spoolie.

name: Lip liner
definition: pencil that outlines the lips with colour.
notes: Target lip pencil results list many lip liners across brands.

name: Bronzer
definition: warm-toned powder or cream that adds a tanned colour to the face.
notes: Sephora Collection matte bronzing powder sold under Bronzer category; shimmer version also.

name: Face powder
definition: loose or pressed powder that sets makeup or mattifies the face.
notes: Bluemercury lists loose and pressed setting powders as face powders.

name: Hair oil
definition: leave-in oil or oil serum applied to lengths and ends to condition and smooth hair.
notes: Hair Oils & Serums category lists Moroccanoil, Olaplex, Wella oils.

name: Heat protectant
definition: spray or cream applied before heat styling to shield hair.
notes: Heat protectant sprays category defends against blow-dryers, irons, curling irons.

name: Bath salts
definition: mineral salt crystals, often scented, dissolved in bath water.
notes: Dr Teal Epsom bath salt, lavender scented, sold in 450g.

name: Fuzz effect
definition: unit that squares the signal into a saturated, buzzing fuzz tone; format is an attribute.
notes: Thomann marks Wampler Cryptid as fuzz; Sweetwater has a Fuzz category.

name: Chorus effect
definition: unit that mixes the signal with slightly delayed, pitch-modulated copies; format is an attribute.
notes: Boss CE-2w sold as chorus pedal; Sweetwater has Chorus category.

name: Flanger effect
definition: unit that mixes the signal with a very short, swept delay for a jet-like comb sweep; format is an attribute.
notes: Boss BF-3 listed as flanger pedal.

name: Phaser effect
definition: unit that sweeps notches through the signal with all-pass filter stages; format is an attribute.
notes: Boss PH-3 sold as phaser pedal in a Phaser category; MXR Phase 95 on Sweetwater.

name: Tremolo effect
definition: unit that modulates the signal volume (or pitch, as vibrato) at a set rate; format is an attribute.
notes: JHS 3 Series Tremolo sold as tremolo effect pedal.

name: Compressor effect
definition: unit that narrows the dynamic range of the instrument signal; format is an attribute.
notes: Sweetwater Compressor Pedals category; Wampler, Keeley, Xotic compressors.

name: Wah effect
definition: foot-rocked or envelope-driven unit that sweeps a resonant filter across the signal.
notes: Dunlop Cry Baby sold as wah pedal; Sweetwater has Wah category.

name: Looper
definition: unit that records and plays back loops of the live signal for overdubbing.
notes: Boss RC-1 sold as looper pedal under Looper Pedals; Sweetwater Looper category.

name: Pitch-shifter effect
definition: unit that adds or replaces the signal with a shifted pitch (octave, harmony, whammy); format is an attribute.
notes: EHX Pitch Fork listed as pitchshifter, up to three octaves either way.

name: EQ effect
definition: unit that boosts or cuts set frequency bands of the instrument signal; format is an attribute.
notes: Sweetwater EQ Pedals category; Boss GE-7 7-band EQ pedal.

name: Noise gate
definition: unit that mutes the signal below a set threshold to cut hum and hiss.
notes: ISP Decimator X listed under effect type Noise Gate.

name: Volume pedal
definition: foot-rocked pedal that sets the level of the instrument signal.
notes: Ernie Ball VP Jr listed as passive volume pedal, Volume/Expression Pedals.

name: Euphonium
definition: valved tenor brass instrument with a wide conical bore, pitched in B-flat.
notes: Thomann sells Bb euphonium under Euphoniums, 14.5 mm bore, Perinet valves.

name: Recorder
definition: duct flute blown at the end through a fipple, with thumb hole; voice size is an attribute.
notes: Thomann lists Moeck alto recorders under Recorders; fipple/thumb hole not stated.

name: Bar chimes
definition: row of hanging metal bars or tubes swept or struck for a shimmering effect.
notes: Meinl sells 27-bar chimes in Chimes category; decorative wind chimes not involved.

name: Small-diaphragm condenser microphone
definition: condenser microphone with a small capsule, sold for recording instruments.
notes: Vintage King category lists Neumann KM 184, Soyuz 013 small diaphragm condensers.

name: Ribbon microphone
definition: velocity microphone with a thin metal ribbon element, sold for music recording.
notes: Sweetwater Ribbon Microphones category: Royer, AEA, Coles; figure-8 pattern.

name: Flugelhorn
definition: valved brass instrument in B-flat with a wide conical bore and mellow tone.
notes: Thomann sells Bb flugelhorns under Flugelhorns, 11 mm bore.

name: Kokyu (Japanese bowed lute)
definition: small bowed spike lute with a skin body; region tag Japan; level provisional (R-19).
notes: Kokyu sold as Japanese bowed string instrument, beginner models; used market listing.

name: Hichiriki (Japanese double-reed pipe)
definition: short cylindrical double-reed pipe of gagaku; region tag Japan; level provisional (R-19).
notes: Hichiriki sold by Japanese sellers; eBay listing may be a novelty model, auction is junk.
